# these events bridge the gap between the vanilla spawning behavior of
# legendary leaders and the mod jam spawning of legendary leaders
# allowing players to pick vanilla leaders as part of the mod jam
# and still have them appear as they do when they spawn naturally
# DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE

namespace = mj24_bridge

# Root = Planet
# From = Country
# FromFrom = Fleet of the science ship that surveyed it, if any
planet_event = {				# spawn azaryn
	id = mj24_bridge.1
	is_triggered_only = yes
	hide_window = yes
	fire_only_once = yes

	trigger = {
		has_planet_flag = azaryn_planet
	}

	immediate = {
		from = {
			country_event = {
				id = first_contact.1060
			}
			country_event = {
				id = paragon.202
			}
		}
	}
}

# A Megastructure has been upgraded
# Root = Country
# From = Megastructure
# FromFrom = System
country_event = {					# spawn skrand
	id = mj24_bridge.2
	is_triggered_only = yes
	hide_window = yes

	trigger = {
		from = {
			has_megastructure_flag = paragon_gateway_dude_homegate_flag
		}
	}
	immediate = {
		set_global_flag = sharpbeak_recruit_phase
		country_event = {
			id = paragon.3000
		}
	}
}

# Root = Planet
# From = Country
# FromFrom = Fleet of the science ship that surveyed it, if any
planet_event = {					 # spawn beholder
	id = mj24_bridge.3
	is_triggered_only = yes
	hide_window = yes

	trigger = {
		has_planet_flag = beholder_planet
	}

	immediate = {
		add_anomaly = {
			category = paragon_beholder_category
			target = from
		}
	}
}

# Root = Planet
# From = Country
# FromFrom = Fleet of the science ship that surveyed it, if any
planet_event = {
	id = mj24_bridge.4
	is_triggered_only = yes
	hide_window = yes

	trigger = {
		has_planet_flag = gray_planet
	}

	immediate = {
		add_anomaly = {
			category = disco_gray_cat
			target = from
		}
	}
}
